meta.title: Taylor Crouch | Full-stack Web Engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of Taylor Crouch, a Tokyo-based full-stack web engineer building multilingual web applications.

top.subtitle: Tokyo-based engineer building multilingual products across frontend, backend, and client delivery.
top.summary: I build and maintain web applications across modern JavaScript stacks, WordPress/PHP, Go services, and Java-based systems. My recent work spans team leadership, client communication, and shipping internal and client-facing tools.

experience.intro: Recent work has focused on shipping multilingual web products, leading small teams, and moving across the stack based on project needs.

roles.title: Full-stack Web Engineer
highlights: Lead teams of 2-5 developers in the delivery of internal and client-facing web applications.
Coordinate with clients on requirements, technical solutions, and project schedules.
Develop and maintain applications across WordPress/PHP, Vue.js frontends, Go services, and Java-based monoliths.
Support multilingual corporate sites, internal tools, and client-facing platforms across multiple environments.

roles.title: Volunteer Web Developer
highlights: Improved responsive behavior and resolved UI/UX issues across devices.
Supported localization updates for a smoother multilingual user experience.
Added end-to-end test coverage with Cypress.
Contributed Django backend updates for performance and feature improvements.

mediaLibraryManager.name: Media Library Manager
mediaLibraryManager.description: A personal media collection platform built to manage and search physical and digital media with secure authentication and external data lookups.
highlights: Designed secure authentication and user-scoped collection management.
Built a modular backend architecture to keep media, auth, and integration concerns separated.
Integrated external metadata services and barcode-assisted lookup to speed up cataloging.
Deployed as a self-hosted project with direct control over the full stack.

sustainabilityPage.title: Sustainability Page
sustainabilityPage.description: Supported a multilingual sustainability platform by improving the UI, localization flow, automated test coverage, and backend functionality.
highlights: Fixed interface issues and improved responsive behavior across device sizes.
Helped improve localization support for a clearer multilingual experience.
Added Cypress end-to-end coverage to reduce regression risk.
Contributed Django backend updates tied to performance and feature work.
